data.action: 单手将炽热的莱瓦汀巨剑抗在肩头，身后熔岩火巨人拔地而起，暗红长发与炽热火星在狂风中疯狂飞扬
data.camera: dramatic low angle, giant flaming sword, floating fire embers, volumetric smoke
data.description: 【史尔特尔 · 火山遗迹】滚烫地热翻涌的火山遗迹裂隙边缘，黑曜石在炽热的地火下泛着幽光。史尔特尔伫立在沸腾的熔岩溪流旁回眸望向你，身后隐隐浮现出庞大的火焰巨人虚影——「这里的温度……和魔剑深处沉睡的声音一模一样。博士，抓紧我的手，可别掉进岩浆里了。」
data.lighting: 熔岩翻滚喷涌的耀眼金红火光，极致的高光与深邃阴影，电影级粒子特效
data.location: 萨卡兹古老火山熔岩祭坛
data.promptProse: Surtr rests burning Laevateinn across one shoulder at the volcanic ruins as a towering flaming giant apparition rises behind the ancient altar. Her red-lined black-and-white jacket, black cropped turtleneck and shorts remain distinct beneath flying red hair. The dramatic low view includes the sword and giant against smoke. Erupting lava and the weapon illuminate armorless fabric edges and altar stone in gold-red light, with deep fissure shadows beneath drifting embers.
data.title: 史尔特尔 · 黄昏灭世·火山烈焰与莱瓦汀巨剑
